report.notes: This manifest records local implementation evidence only. No real Waffo Sandbox request, payment-method inquiry, production Webhook delivery, or production credential has been exercised. Agent D was unavailable because of the account usage limit; the coordinator completed the scoped correction locally.

fixes.rootCause: A successful inquiry response was previously treated as proof of every write operation
fixes.fixSummary: Recovery now interprets operation-specific statuses and frozen result fields, and never performs a second write

fixes.rootCause: Subscription activation did not verify the local order payment facts
fixes.fixSummary: Activation and renewal now verify amount and currency before state mutation or grant

remediation: Confirm userTerminal, subscription mode and retry policy before production startup.
Provide Sandbox credentials, MID, HTTPS notify/redirect URLs and payMethodConfig inquiry evidence.
Run project-endpoint integration verification and regenerate the formal report only after the report gate passes.
